summary: Frontend-only E2E testing (no backend) of Diedo/Vilma AI FASE 1 on the external preview URL. Covered: root redirect to /dashboard, sidebar navigation (Vista General <-> Terminal POS, desktop + mobile drawer), dashboard period filters with KPI/chart recompute, POS product grid, category bubbles, search by name/SKU, add-to-cart + toast, qty steppers (inc/dec/dec-to-0/trash), discount input (incl. clamp 0-100), customer selector + search, branch selector, payment tabs, Transferencia inline validation, checkout success + cart clear, Imprimir/Descargar/Gasto mock actions, Gasto modal inline validation, Limpiar, empty state + disabled Cobrar, sold-out product disabled, 'Sin resultados' empty state, cart persistence after reload, desktop sticky RIGHT cart sidebar layout verification, and mobile (390px) FAB + bottom-sheet drawer. Result: all 14 requested flows PASS. No JS page errors. Only cosmetic/minor issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: The drawer close (X) button is absolutely positioned at top-right and overlaps the CartPanel header actions — the 'Limpiar' button is clipped/covered ('Lim...' visible under the X), making it hard/impossible to tap on mobile.
Success toast shows unformatted amount: 'Gasto registrado: TEST_Compra insumos · DOP$ 500' instead of formatDOP style 'DOP$ 500.00' used everywhere else.

issues: Recharts console warning repeated on every render: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0...' — ResponsiveContainer measures a zero/negative-size parent on first paint (add minHeight/explicit height to the chart wrapper). Chart still renders correctly.
Period filter pills wrap to two lines ('Esta semana', 'Este mes') making the segmented control uneven in height — consider smaller text/horizontal scroll.
With a 100% discount the Total becomes DOP$ 0.00 and 'Cobrar · DOP$ 0.00' remains enabled — business rule may want to block a zero-value sale (informational).

action_items: Fix mobile cart drawer close-button overlap with the 'Limpiar' action in the CartPanel header (e.g., add right padding to header on mobile or move the close button).
Format the Gasto success toast amount with formatDOP.
Silence/fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer width/height(-1) warning by giving the chart container an explicit height/minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: CartPanel is rendered twice on mobile (CartSidebar is display:none but mounted, CartDrawer mounts on open) — duplicate data-testids exist in the DOM when the drawer is open; automated tests must filter by visibility. Consider rendering only one instance based on viewport.

posStore.getSubtotal/getTotal are store methods returning fresh values; components subscribe to `items` so re-render works, but selecting derived getters (e.g. usePosStore(s => s.getItemCount())) recomputes each render — fine now, watch for perf later.

posStore persists items/discount/customer but not transferProof/paymentMethod-proof pairing; after reload with 'transferencia' persisted, the proof is null and checkout correctly blocks — acceptable, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (14/14), 2 cosmetic issues

seed_data_creation: None (all data is mock). Test expense 'TEST_Compra insumos' was only a toast, not persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Always run localStorage.clear() before POS tests (posStore persists the cart under key 'diedo-pos'). Selector caution: '[data-testid^="pos-product-"]' also matches 'pos-product-grid' (counts are off by one). On mobile, both CartSidebar (hidden) and CartDrawer contain the same testids — use visible-scoped locators. Verified prices are formatted 'DOP$ 1,200.00', ITBIS 18%, and the desktop cart is a real right-side sticky sidebar (x=1520, width=400 at 1920px).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Mobile drawer overlap RCA: CartDrawer places an absolutely positioned close button at right-4/top-4 over the CartPanel header row which already contains 'Item' and 'Limpiar' buttons, with no reserved padding.
